recommended_datasets.name: Google - Isolated Sign Language Recognition (GISLR / PopSign v1.0 Subset)
recommended_datasets.owner: Google Research, Georgia Institute of Technology, and Deaf Professional Arts Network (DPAN)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Kaggle login + accept competition rules + Kaggle CLI (`kaggle competitions download -c asl-signs`)
recommended_datasets.file_format: ZIP archive containing `train.csv`, `sign_to_prediction_index_map.json`, and 94,477 Apache Parquet files (`train_landmark_files/<participant_id>/<sequence_id>.parquet`)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: Pre-extracted 3D coordinates from 1944x2592 portrait smartphone video @ 30 fps (543 landmarks/frame: 468 face, 33 pose, 21 left_hand, 21 right_hand)
recommended_datasets.notes: Rank #1 Primary Dataset for Stage C1 (Commercial-Safe 250-Sign Core) and backbone pretraining. Ships pre-extracted MediaPipe Holistic landmarks (both hands, pose, face), eliminating video decoding overhead. Portrait aspect ratio (~0.75) requires `--aspect 0.75` normalization in `ml/gislr_to_features.py`. Missing `ME`, `YOU`, `NAME`, `WHAT`, which must be supplemented from first-party recordings or ASL Citizen.

recommended_datasets.name: Google - American Sign Language Fingerspelling Recognition (ASLFR / FSboard Subset)
recommended_datasets.owner: Google Research, Georgia Tech, RIT, Tulane University, and DPAN
recommended_datasets.access_method: Kaggle login + accept competition rules + Kaggle CLI (`kaggle competitions download -c asl-fingerspelling` or preprocessed `.npy` mirror `darraghdog/asl-fingerspelling-preprocessing-train-dataset`)
recommended_datasets.content_type: pre-extracted landmarks (continuous fingerspelling of words, names, addresses, phone numbers, URLs)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: Pre-extracted MediaPipe Holistic landmarks (543 points x 3D) from 1944x2592 selfie video @ 30 fps
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: character sequence / English phrase text (59 character classes: a-z, 0-9, space, punctuation)
recommended_datasets.notes: Rank #1 Primary Dataset for Stage B (Fingerspelling A-Z, 0-9, and continuous fingerspelled names/words). Captures real co-articulation, letter bounces, and dynamic letters J and Z. Preprocessed numpy mirror (`darraghdog`) fits easily on free Colab/Kaggle 20 GB disk.

recommended_datasets.name: FSboard (Full Smartphone Fingerspelling Corpus)
recommended_datasets.owner: Google Research, Tulane University, RIT, and DPAN (Georg et al., 2024/2025)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Public cloud storage / Kaggle competition subset (`asl-fingerspelling` provides the immediate pre-extracted Parquet landmarks)
recommended_datasets.file_format: MP4 video + MediaPipe Holistic 30 Hz landmarks
recommended_datasets.content_type: fingerspelling (continuous phrases, MacKenzie set, names, addresses, URLs, phone numbers)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: English character sequences (3.2 million characters total)
recommended_datasets.notes: Full superset of the Kaggle ASLFR competition (117 train / 15 val / 15 test signers, zero phrase overlap). Use the `kaggle-aslfr` pre-extracted Parquet subset first to save 200+ GB of storage and video extraction compute.

recommended_datasets.name: ASL Citizen (Version 1.0)
recommended_datasets.owner: Microsoft Research, Boston University, University of Washington, and RIT (Desai et al., NeurIPS 2023)
recommended_datasets.license: Microsoft Research Data License Agreement (Research Use Only; contact ASL_Citizen@microsoft.com for commercial licensing)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct HTTP download via `wget` or Microsoft Download Center (no login or form required)
recommended_datasets.file_format: ZIP archive containing 83,399 `.mp4` videos, signer-independent split CSVs (`train: 40,154`, `val: 10,304`, `test: 32,941`), ASL-LEX mapping, and `Demographics.zip` (5.0 KB)
recommended_datasets.content_type: isolated signs (webcam recordings in everyday home settings)
recommended_stages: Stage C (Tier C2: 1,000-2,731 sign Research Model)
recommended_datasets.notes: Rank #1 Dataset for Stage C2 (Large-Vocabulary 1,000-2,731 Sign Recognition). Direct `wget` download works with zero link rot, filmed on everyday webcams matching SignLine's domain, with IRB-approved consent and standardized signer-independent splits (35 train / 6 val / 11 test signers). Strict Research-Only license: keep weights in `ml/out/research_only/`.

recommended_datasets.name: How2Sign & How2Sign Holistic (Pre-extracted MediaPipe Landmarks)
recommended_datasets.owner: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), CMU, Facebook AI Research, Boston University (Duarte et al., CVPR 2021); Holistic extraction curated by PSewmuthu on Hugging Face
recommended_datasets.official_keypoints_info: https://how2sign.github.io/ (B-F-H 2D Keypoints clips: Train 21 GB, Val 1.2 GB, Test 1.6 GB; Green Screen RGB clips: Train 31 GB, Val 1.7 GB, Test 2.2 GB)
recommended_datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International on underlying How2Sign corpus; Hugging Face wrapper card specifies MIT)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct download via Hugging Face CLI (`hf download PSewmuthu/How2Sign_Holistic --repo-type dataset`) or How2Sign download script
recommended_datasets.file_format: NumPy `.npy` frame-level MediaPipe Holistic landmark arrays (frontal and side views) + tab-separated metadata CSVs (`how2sign_realigned_train.csv`, `val.csv`, `test.csv`)
recommended_datasets.content_type: continuous signing + pre-extracted landmarks (sentence-level instructional videos)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: 1280x720 @ 30 fps (studio green screen, synchronized frontal + side RGB, depth, and MediaPipe Holistic keypoints)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: English sentence translations (manually re-aligned timestamps; gloss annotations partial/not publicly bundled in main CSV)
recommended_datasets.notes: Rank #1 Dataset for Stage D (Continuous Signing). Providing pre-extracted MediaPipe Holistic `.npy` landmarks on Hugging Face (`33.8 GB`) saves downloading 600+ GB of raw green-screen video. Non-commercial (`CC BY-NC 4.0`). Only 11 signers, so encoder backbones must be initialized from GISLR/ASL Citizen to preserve signer generalization.

recommended_datasets.name: PopSign ASL v1.0 & v2.1 (Full Smartphone Video Dataset)
recommended_datasets.owner: Georgia Institute of Technology & Deaf Professional Arts Network (Starner et al., NeurIPS 2023)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Open access via Georgia Tech Contextual Computing Group portal (`signdata.cc.gatech.edu`)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: gloss (250 MacArthur-Bates CDI signs in v1.0; expanded to 563 signs in v2.1)
recommended_stages: Stage C (Commercial expansion beyond 250 signs via v2.1)
recommended_datasets.notes: Commercial-safe (`CC BY 4.0`) parent corpus of Kaggle GISLR. Because raw v1.0 video is 1.1 TB, use `kaggle-gislr` (39.6 GB pre-extracted landmarks) for the first 250 signs, and only stream/extract the additional 313 signs from PopSign v2.1 if scaling the commercial model to 563 signs.

recommended_datasets.name: WLASL (Word-Level American Sign Language) & Voxel51 Hugging Face Mirror
recommended_datasets.owner: Australian National University / Data61 CSIRO (Li et al., WACV 2020); mirror hosted by Voxel51
recommended_datasets.license: C-UDA-1.0 (Computational Use of Data Agreement v1.0 — Academic/Computational Use Only, No Commercial Use)
recommended_datasets.access_method: GitHub scraper (`yt-dlp` + `WLASL_v0.3.json`) or direct Hugging Face download (`Voxel51/WLASL`, 11,980 surviving clips, 5.5 GB)
recommended_datasets.file_format: MP4 clips + JSON metadata (`WLASL_v0.3.json` with bbox, fps=25, frame_start, frame_end, signer_id, dialect variation_id)
recommended_datasets.content_type: isolated signs (scraped from ASL dictionary/tutoring sites and YouTube)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: Variable web resolutions normalized to 25 fps
recommended_stages: Stage C (Plan B fallback / cross-dataset benchmark)
recommended_datasets.notes: Approximately 43% of original YouTube/web URLs are dead (`11,980 / 21,083` survive in the 5.5 GB Voxel51 Hugging Face mirror). Original paper splits overlapped signers between train and test; must re-split by `signer_id` if used. Non-commercial (`C-UDA-1.0`) and scraped without explicit signer consent; ASL Citizen is strongly preferred.

recommended_datasets.name: ChicagoFSWild & ChicagoFSWild+
recommended_datasets.owner: TTI-Chicago and University of Chicago (Shi, Del Rio, Keane, Brentari, Shakhnarovich, Livescu, SLT 2018 / ICCV 2019)
recommended_datasets.license: Custom Research Notice (Released publicly for research; commercial status UNVERIFIED / restricted per Google FSboard paper footnote 3)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct HTTP download of `.tgz` archives (no login required)
recommended_datasets.file_format: TGZ archives containing extracted `.jpg` frame sequences, `ChicagoFSWild.csv`, and `HandAnnotation.csv` bounding boxes
recommended_datasets.content_type: fingerspelling (short continuous fingerspelling clips mined from online ASL videos)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: Variable web resolutions (640x360 average, cropped around signer/hands)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: character sequence (`label_proc`) + signer ID + hand dominance metadata (86.9% right-handed, 10.6% left-handed, 2.5% both)
recommended_stages: Stage B (Plan B fallback & in-the-wild webcam validation)
recommended_datasets.notes: Self-contained `.tgz` downloads (no YouTube link rot) with explicit handedness labels. Excellent Plan B and cross-domain evaluation set for Stage B fingerspelling, though Kaggle ASLFR / FSboard is 10x larger and CC BY 4.0 licensed.

recommended_datasets.name: ASL-LEX 2.0 (Lexical and Phonological Database)
recommended_datasets.owner: Boston University, San Diego State University, and Tufts University (Caselli, Sehyr, Cohen-Goldberg, Emmorey, 2021)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct GitHub clone or CSV download from `asl-lex.org`
recommended_datasets.file_format: CSV / JSON lexical property tables (EntryID, English translations, handshape, location, movement, one-handed vs two-handed, symmetry, iconicity, frequency)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: Reference dictionary clips + tabular phonological metadata
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: gloss + phonological features (handshape, major/minor location, movement, dominant/non-dominant hand usage)
recommended_stages: Stage C (Vocabulary merging & 1-hand vs 2-hand phonological validation)
recommended_datasets.notes: Provides the canonical 2,723-sign taxonomy used by both ASL Citizen and Sem-Lex, plus explicit ground-truth annotations for whether each sign is 1-handed or 2-handed (symmetrical vs asymmetrical).

recommended_datasets.name: DailyMoth-70h (SSVP-SLT Benchmark)
recommended_datasets.owner: Meta FAIR, University of Copenhagen, UC Berkeley, and The Daily Moth (Rust et al., August 2024)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct download via scripts in `facebookresearch/ssvp_slt` repository
recommended_datasets.file_format: Self-contained cropped 224x224 MP4 clips (blurred and unblurred versions) + SRT/JSON English caption alignments
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: English translation (sentence fragments aligned via SRT, mean 5.6s / 8.6 words per clip)
recommended_datasets.notes: Self-contained download with formal license agreement from The Daily Moth (no YouTube scraping required). Because it contains only 1 native signer, it is useful for sequence-to-sequence translation ablations in Stage D (achieving 28.8 BLEU-4) but cannot train a signer-independent visual encoder alone.

recommended_datasets.name: OpenASL
recommended_datasets.owner: TTI-Chicago and University of Chicago (Shi, Brentari, Shakhnarovich, Livescu, EMNLP 2022; repo updated July 2025)
recommended_datasets.file_format: TSV metadata (`openasl-v1.0.tsv`), bounding boxes (`bbox-v1.0.json`), and YouTube-scraped MP4 clips
recommended_datasets.content_type: continuous signing (open-domain news/vlogs from DailyMoth, Sign1News, NAD)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: English sentence translations (no manual gloss annotations)
recommended_datasets.notes: Contains `NoDerivatives` (`CC BY-NC-ND 4.0`) restriction and requires scraping YouTube via `yt-dlp` (with ~15-20% link rot). Do not distribute derivative weights trained on OpenASL.

recommended_datasets.name: YouTube-ASL
recommended_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (on released video ID list; underlying videos subject to YouTube Terms of Service)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Download list of 11,093 YouTube video IDs and scrape videos + captions via `yt-dlp`
recommended_datasets.file_format: Text file of YouTube video IDs (`youtube_asl_video_ids.txt`)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: English captions (user-uploaded, filtered by Deaf annotators; no gloss annotations)
recommended_datasets.notes: Largest open-domain ASL corpus (~984 hours), but ships ONLY YouTube video IDs (no timestamps, captions, or landmarks hosted directly), requires scraping 11k videos (~800 GB, high rate-limiting and link rot), and took 64 A100 GPUs for 2 weeks in SSVP-SLT. Infeasible for low-cost compute; documented for completeness.

recommended_datasets.name: The Sem-Lex Benchmark
recommended_datasets.owner: University of Southern California, Boston University, Gallaudet, SDSU (Kezar et al., ASSETS 2023)
recommended_datasets.license: Apache-2.0 (repository code); Custom Terms of Use Agreement Form for video data (Research Use Only)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Requires human submission of Terms of Use agreement form linked on GitHub README
recommended_datasets.file_format: MP4 isolated sign videos (pose estimation files noted as 'coming soon' on README)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: gloss + ASL-LEX 2.0 phoneme labels + ASL SignBank alignment
recommended_datasets.notes: Can be combined with ASL Citizen for ~174k total videos across 3,149 signs, but requires waiting for a manual Terms of Use form approval and pre-extracted poses are not yet posted in the repo. Use ASL Citizen (direct `wget`) first.

recommended_datasets.name: MS-ASL (Microsoft American Sign Language Dataset)
recommended_datasets.license: C-UDA-1.0 (Computational Use of Data Agreement — Research/Academic Only)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Download JSON annotations (`MSASL_train.json`, `val.json`, `test.json`) + scrape YouTube URLs
recommended_datasets.file_format: JSON metadata (YouTube URLs, start/end timestamps, bounding boxes, signer IDs)
recommended_datasets.notes: Not recommended as primary training source: ships only YouTube URLs from 2018 (~45-50% dead links today) under non-commercial C-UDA-1.0. Superseded by Microsoft's own direct-download ASL Citizen dataset.

recommended_datasets.name: Boston University ASLLRP: ASLLVD & NCSLGR / SignStream 3 Corpora
recommended_datasets.owner: Boston University, Rutgers University, and UT Arlington (Neidle, Sclaroff, Athitsos, Metaxas)
recommended_datasets.license: BU ASLLRP Terms of Use (Research and Education Only; No Commercial Use, Patents, or Redistribution)
recommended_datasets.access_method: Direct HTTP download via Boston University / Rutgers DAI portal
recommended_datasets.file_format: QuickTime `.mov` / `.mp4`, custom `.vid`, and `.xlsx` / `.xml` SignStream linguistic annotations
recommended_datasets.content_type: isolated signs (ASLLVD) + continuous sentences with non-manual grammatical markers (NCSLGR / SignStream 3)
recommended_datasets.resolution_fps: 640x480 @ 60 fps (4 synchronized studio views: front, side, face close-up, 1600x1200 HD front)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: gloss + start/end handshapes + morphological type + non-manual grammatical tiers (brow raise, wh-question, negation, headshake)
recommended_stages: Stage D (Evaluating non-manual facial grammar rules `Q-YN`, `Q-WH`, `NEG`)
recommended_datasets.notes: Too few signers (6 in ASLLVD, 4 in NCSLGR) for general visual backbone training, and strictly non-commercial, but NCSLGR / SignStream 3 is the gold-standard linguistic benchmark for validating eyebrow/headshake non-manual grammatical markers (`Q-YN`, `Q-WH`, `NEG`).

recommended_datasets.name: ASL Alphabet (Static Image Dataset)
recommended_datasets.annotation_type: character class folder (A-Z, SPACE, DELETE, NOTHING)
recommended_datasets.notes: Audited as a well-known candidate, but NOT recommended for primary training: contains static 200x200 crops from a single/few signers (cannot model motion-dependent letters J and Z or temporal co-articulation) and carries a viral GPL 2.0 license. Use `kaggle-aslfr` (CC BY 4.0) instead.
